description:
, a leading online retailer of office and commercial products based in Los Angeles, is expanding our eCommerce content team and looking for a Detail-Oriented and Tech-Savvy eCommerce Product Content Specialists. If you have a passion for organizing and optimizing product content, and you’re ready for a long-term, stable position, this role could be perfect for you!



In this role, you will be responsible for researching, analyzing, and curating product information to create an exceptional, user-friendly shopping experience. Using AI, Magento ecommerce, and your skills you'll ensure all product content is accurate, compelling, and optimized to drive conversions. 



Key Responsibilities:

* Research & Curate Product Information: Gather and organize product data from manufacturers and suppliers, ensuring all details are clear and up-to-date.

* Content Optimization: Edit and optimize product listings to enhance SEO, improve visibility, and maximize conversion rates on our website.

* Magento Content Management: Use our Magento platform to manage and update product content, ensuring everything is accurate and in line with our standards.

* Ongoing Content Review: Regularly audit existing product listings and make updates to enhance quality and relevance.

* Collaboration: Work closely with other teams to ensure content aligns with our overall marketing and sales goals.



Requirements:

* Proficient in English: Excellent reading, writing, and speaking skills.

* Excel Expertise: Strong working knowledge of Excel, including various formulas for data organization and analysis.

* Basic Photoshop Skills: Ability to perform simple image editing tasks.

* Basic HTML Knowledge: Some familiarity with HTML to edit product listings and web pages.

* eCommerce Catalog Experience: Experience with platforms such as Magento, BigCommerce, Shopify, or similar eCommerce systems.

* Full-Time Availability: Ability to work 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of daily overlap (8 AM to 6 PM PST).

* Exclusivity: This is a full-time role, and applicants must commit to this position exclusively (no other jobs).



Preferred (But Not Required):

* Graphic Design Experience: Experience with design software (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator).

* Copywriting Skills: Ability to craft compelling product descriptions and content.

* Project Management Tools: Familiarity with Asana, ClickUp, Trello, or Jira.

* SEO/SEM Knowledge: Basic understanding of keyword significance for SEO and SEM purposes.



Benefits & Perks:

* Paid Time Off (PTO): 20 days of paid leave per year

* Training Opportunities: Continuous learning and professional development.

* Job Stability: A long-term position with the potential for performance-based hourly rate increases.

* Career Growth: Clear pathways for career advancement within the company.

* Collaborative & Supportive Work Culture: Join a friendly, family-like team that values your contributions and offers a supportive environment for long-term success.



How to Apply: Please submit your resume/CV. Submissions without resumes will not be considered.

Experience with Looker Studio or other reporting platforms.

Experience supporting lead generation and performance marketing campaigns.

Campaign pacing accuracy

Budget management effectiveness

Reporting quality and accuracy

Optimization implementation speed

CPA and ROAS improvements

Quality and actionability of performance insights

Effective use of AI tools to increase productivity and campaign performance



This position is ideal for a strong execution-focused paid media professional who can independently manage day-to-day campaign operations while using both data and AI-driven insights to improve performance.

title: Video Content Creation + Admin VA
description:
We are a growing YouTube & Tiktok-based content business looking for one specific type of person: 



> Someone who is highly detail-oriented, follows systems precisely, and can edit talking head and faceless videos to a professional standard.



This is NOT a general VA role. Video editing is the core of this position — 90% of what you will do. If you cannot edit cleanly, follow a workflow exactly as shown, and QA (Quality Review) your own work before submission, this role is not for you.



?  Read carefully. This role requires a specific skill set and mindset. If you're the right fit, you'll know it immediately.

__________________________________



THE ROLE

You will edit talking head and faceless educational videos using CapCut desktop (paid/Pro version required). You will follow a specific workflow that has been developed and refined for this business. You will QA your own work during editing — not after — and submit clean videos that do not require correction.



You will also handle supporting admin tasks once video editing is mastered.

___________________________________



VIDEO EDITING - PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY (85%)

This is the most important part of the role. Everything else is secondary.

•  Edit talking head and faceless videos in CapCut desktop (Pro version required)

•  Follow a precise 3-step workflow: cut audio ? sync video ? QA simultaneously during editing

•  Extract audio from video clips and manage audio/video tracks separately on the timeline

•  Remove mistakes, pauses, breaths, and dead air with clean, undetectable cuts

•  Ensure no words are cut off — every word must complete fully before a cut

•  Eliminate all screen jumps — mouse movement must be natural and continuous across every clip transition

•  Ensure all audio clips are directly adjacent on the timeline — no gaps

•  QA during editing, not after — you should know your video is clean before you submit it

•  Complete a full QA checklist before every submission

•  Target turnaround: 20-minute video edited and submitted within 4 hours

•  Add end screens, CTAs, captions, thumbnails, and descriptions for YouTube and TikTok

* Add graphics, text, pop-ups and motion graphics on video

___________________________________



ADMIN/OPERATIONS SUPPORT - SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITY (15%)



•  Social media research and engagement using provided SOPs

•  Community management (comments, conversation starters)

•  Manage tasks and deadlines in Asana and Slack

•  Update sales systems, lead information, and website content

•  Proofread and update documents and spreadsheets accurately

•  Daily and weekly reporting - research and data entry



________________________________



MUST HAVE

If you cannot meet all of the following, do not apply.

•  CapCut desktop — paid/Pro version — installed and ready before start date

•  Able to edit a 20-minute talking head video within 4 hours once trained

•  Available to work EST hours (evenings 6–9 PM EST for training for the first 2-3 weeks, daytime EST after training)

•  Follows workflows exactly as taught — no substituting your own methods

•  Takes detailed notes during training and does not ask repeated questions

•  Submits a completed QA checklist with every video — no exceptions

•  Does not submit work with obvious errors — you catch your own mistakes

________________________________



YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE

•  A background that required extreme attention to detail — QA/compliance, medical billing, insurance operations, paralegal, data auditing, finance, claims processing, or similar

•  Proven experience editing talking head or faceless YouTube videos

•  A structured, analytical mindset — you think critically when something looks or sounds wrong

•  Strong time management — you complete work on deadline without dragging hours

•  CapCut desktop experience (required) — Adobe Premiere or Final Cut Pro is a plus

•  Experience with Asana, Notion, ClickUp, or Slack

•  Canva experience for thumbnails and basic graphics



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

$3–6 USD/hour depending on experience and performance after training ($2.50 Per hour during training)

•  Paid weekly

•  13th-month pay

•  Monthly performance bonuses for exceeding KPIs

•  Annual retention bonus review

•  Performance-based raises

•  Promotion path — top performers can grow into team lead roles

•  Ongoing skill training (AI, social media, video editing, copywriting, and more)

•  Stable, long-term employment with clear systems, SOPs, and feedback

___________________________



HOW TO APPLY - READ EVERY STEP

Send an
 to 
 with the subject line:

"Applying To – Video Editor VA – [Your Name]"



Include ALL of the following in your
:



1. Your OnlineJobs.ph profile link

2. Resume (PDF)

3. A 1–2 minute intro video: tell us who you are, your editing experience, and what makes you the right fit for this specific role

4. A video editing sample — ideally a talking head or faceless video you have edited. No sample = no consideration.

5. Confirm you have CapCut desktop Pro installed and ready

7. Put the word EAGLE at the end of your
 so we know you read this in full

You take detailed notes the first time something is taught so you don't need it repeated.

When you hit a problem, you think through it before asking for help.

You take ownership of your output — errors in your work are your responsibility to catch, not your employer's.



If that description sounds like you, keep reading. If it doesn't, this role will be frustrating for both of us.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are a growing YouTube-based content business producing talking head and faceless educational videos. This is an operations support role — you will help keep the content engine running cleanly and efficiently.



The role has three areas. They are listed in order of priority:



•  Video editing — this is the core of the role and where your attention to detail matters most

•  Admin and operations support

•  Graphics and visual content



You do not need to be an expert in all three from day one. You need to have the right mindset and be trainable. The workflow for video editing will be taught to you in full. What cannot be taught is the ability to follow it precisely and catch your own mistakes.



VIDEO EDITING — PRIMARY FOCUS

?  This is the most important part of the role. Everything else is secondary to this.

You will edit talking head and faceless YouTube videos using CapCut desktop (Pro version required). You will be trained on a specific 3-step workflow. Your job is to learn it, apply it exactly, and deliver clean videos that do not need correction.



What that looks like in practice:

•  Cut audio, sync video, and QA simultaneously — not separately, not after

•  No words cut off mid-syllable — every word completes fully before a cut

•  No screen jumps — mouse movement must be natural and continuous across every clip

•  No audio gaps — all clips butted directly together on the timeline

•  Audio extracted and managed separately from the video track

•  Complete a QA checklist before every submission — no exceptions

•  Target turnaround: 20-minute video edited and submitted within 4 hours once trained



You do not need years of editing experience. You need CapCut desktop familiarity, a trained eye for detail, and the ability to absorb and apply a workflow the first time it is shown to you.



ADMIN & OPERATIONS SUPPORT

•  Social media research and engagement using provided SOPs

•  Community management — comments, conversation starters, engagement

•  Manage and track tasks in Asana and Slack

•  Update sales systems, lead tracking, and website content as needed

•  Data entry, spreadsheet tracking, and document management

•  Daily and weekly reporting



GRAPHICS & VISUAL CONTENT

•  Create thumbnails and social media graphics using Canva

•  Maintain consistency with brand templates and visual standards

•  Design basic promotional and content visuals as directed



WHO YOU ARE

The best candidates for this role have come from backgrounds that demanded precision — not just creativity. If your prior work required you to get things exactly right with no room for error, you'll fit here.



Backgrounds that translate well:

•  QA or compliance

•  Medical billing or insurance operations

•  Data entry auditing or claims processing

•  Paralegal or legal support

•  Finance, payroll, or bookkeeping

•  Social media management with a strong analytical component

•  Any role where following a system exactly was non-negotiable



You also need:

•  CapCut desktop — Pro/paid version — installed before your start date

•  Availability EST hours — training is 6–9 PM EST, flexible after probation

•  Strong English communication — written and verbal

•  Experience with Asana, Notion, ClickUp, or similar tools

•  Canva experience — thumbnails and basic graphics

•  Reliable internet and a working laptop capable of running CapCut desktop



NON-NEGOTIABLES

If you cannot commit to all of the following, do not apply.

•  CapCut desktop Pro installed and confirmed before start date

•  Available EST hours for training and regular check-ins

•  Follows the taught workflow exactly — no substituting your own methods

•  Takes detailed notes during training — does not ask the same question twice

•  Submits a completed QA checklist with every video

•  Does not submit work with obvious errors — you catch your own mistakes before handoff

•  Able to complete a 20-minute video edit within 4 hours once trained and independent



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

•  $3–5 USD/hour based on experience and performance ($2.50 per hour for training)

•  Paid weekly

•  13th-month pay

•  Monthly performance bonuses for exceeding KPIs

•  Annual retention bonus review

•  Performance-based raises

•  Promotion path — top performers can grow into team lead and management roles

•  Ongoing skill development — AI tools, social media, writing, video editing, and more

•  Stable, long-term employment with clear SOPs, systems, and feedback



HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW EVERY STEP



Attention to detail starts with how you apply. Applications missing any step will not be reviewed.



Send an
 to 
 with the subject line:

"Applying To – Analytical VA – [Your Name]"



Include ALL of the following in your
, in this exact order:



1. Your OnlineJobs.ph profile link

2. Resume as a PDF

3. A 1–2 minute intro video: tell us who you are, your relevant background, and why your attention to detail makes you the right fit for this role specifically

4. A video editing sample — a talking head or faceless video you have edited. No sample = no consideration

5. Confirm you have CapCut desktop Pro installed and ready to use

6. Confirm you are available to work EST hours

7. Write the word FALCON at the end of your
 to confirm you read this posting in full

About Us

We are Matt & Markus - Two experienced Online Marketing Experts with a combined 20+ years of PPC experience. We specialize in running high performing Google Ads campaigns. Additionally, we support clients with in depth data analysis and conversion optimization. 



We have been working independently as freelancers for many years and teamed up to build and grow our Google Ads agency in 2025. The agency is growing and with that growth we are building a strong team to be part of the journey.



About the Role

We are a growing performance marketing agency focused on delivering data-driven PPC campaigns for international clients. Our main expertise lies within Google Ads.

We are looking for a Senior PPC Manager with several (4+) years of experience with Google Ads to take ownership of our PPC accounts, drive growth, and operate with a high level of independence.

You will work closely with the founders while also owning execution, strategy, and performance across accounts.



Key Responsibilities

- Account Ownership & Performance

- Manage PPC accounts end-to-end across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube)

- Take full ownership of results (scaling volume, improving performance, driving growth)

- Support and mentor junior tea
mbers when needed

Experience

- Experience managing multiple accounts independently

- GA4 + GTM

- Conversion tracking and attribution

- Offline conversions

- Looker Studio



Mindset

- Highly proactive and accountable

- Strong problem solver who figures things out independently

- Commercially aware (focus on business outcomes, not just metrics)

- Comfortable making decisions without constant guidance

- Ownership (and being able to take responsibility for wins and mistakes)

- Critical thinking (and being able to say “I see it different”)

- Someone who enjoys life and is generally positive and can laugh while delivering high quality work

- Relies heavily on AI tools without understanding the work

Salary

Based on experience

- Minimal hand-holding required

- Written Summary of your PPC experience and where you see your personal strength

- Examples of accounts you’ve scaled (include results)

We are looking forward to receive your application and to get to know you.



Best wishes,

Markus and Matt

title: Virtual Assistant, Operations Expert for Career Coaching & Speaking Practice Remote |
description:
Virtual Assistant, Operations Expert for Career Coaching & Speaking Practice

Remote | Philippines-Based | Part-Time to Full-Time





Most VA job posts want someone who is good at following instructions.



This one is a bit different.



Yes, there are tasks. Research to do. Resumes to reformat. Asana and CRM to manage. Outreach
s to send. 



But the person who thrives here isn't just executing a checklist, I need someone who looks at a half-finished process and, excitedly, thinks "I can make this better." Someone who catches a problem before being asked. Someone who takes ownership and runs with it.



If that's how you work, keep reading.





About the Role

You'll work directly with a U.S.-based career coach and keynote speaker — a one-person practice with a growing pipeline and no signs of slowing down. The work is varied and won't repeat itself. One week, you're processing 50+ post-event survey responses and running segmented outreach. The next, you're reformatting a resume that could change someone's career trajectory, or finalizing content for an upcoming speaking engagement.



Every workflow has a Loom walkthrough, a custom AI prompt, or a written doc behind it. You'll never be guessing what "done" looks like. But documentation is a starting point — once you know a process, you're expected to make it better.



This starts at 20 hours a week. The path to 40 hours is there, and it's based on one thing: trust earned through consistent work, communication, and process improvement.





What You'll Actually Do

Resume & Career Documents 

Reformat and polish resumes in Microsoft Word using custom AI prompts

Convert resumes into LinkedIn summaries, cover letters, and other career documents

Use AI tools to produce clean, human-sounding output — not raw generated text dropped into a template



Speaking & Event Operations

Process post-event
 campaigns: sort 50+ audience survey responses, send segmented outreach by response type

Conduct LinkedIn outreach to event attendees using provided templates

Track pre- and post-talk logistics in Asana



Content & Social

Schedule and publish content on LinkedIn and other platforms

Take 70%-complete drafts and get them ready to publish — close the gaps, fix the formatting, make it land



Business Development Support

Support B2B outreach to wealth management firms and companies going through layoffs

Help maintain outreach sequences and track pipeline activity



Operations & Reporting

Manage Asana daily: update task statuses, flag what needs attention, keep dashboards current

Send daily and weekly activity reports — the owner should always know what's moving





Who You Are

You write English at a professional level and you've actually worked with AI tools — meaning you know how to take generated output and make it sound like a person wrote it.



You're organized in a way that shows up in your work, not just how you describe yourself. You finish things. When something's stuck, you say so before it becomes a problem. When a process is unclear, you ask one sharp question and move forward.



You're comfortable working async. You don't need daily check-ins to stay on track.





Required:



Comfortable learning from Loom videos and async documentation

Professional written English

Asana or similar project management experience

Real experience with Claude (my preferred AI of choice) — with the judgment to refine output, not just use it

Google Suite and Microsoft Office proficiency for document formatting

Experience managing LinkedIn or other social platforms

Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup



Bonus:

Background in career coaching, staffing, or HR

B2B outreach or lead generation experience

Experience with content calendars or social scheduling tools





Compensation & Schedule

Hourly: $8–$10 USD 

Hours: 20 hrs/week to start, path to 40 hrs 

Schedule: Flexible async with 2–3 hours daily overlap at 2:00 PM Pacific (5:00 AM Philippine Time) 

Start: ASAP





Before You Apply

Know you won't be thrown in without context. There are Loom walkthroughs, documented workflows, and AI prompts for the tasks that need them. The systems are there and being updated. 



I welcome any and all recommendations, tools, hacks, and automations. I want both of us to work smarter, not just harder. 



If you want a role where you wait for instructions, I don’t think this will be a good fit.



If you want to have input and ownership of the day to day, grow into a bigger role, and become a key part of growth and strategy, please apply!

title: PPC Manager (Google & Bing Ads)
description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced PPC Manager to lead the development, execution, and optimization of paid search campaigns across both Google Ads and Bing Ads. The ideal candidate will have a hands-on understanding of both platforms and proven success managing large-scale, complex campaigns with significant budgets. You will be responsible for delivering results-driven campaigns that align with client goals while maintaining a deep understanding of industry best practices. Previous experience working at Google or a strong insider knowledge of Google Ads best practices is highly advantageous.

As a PPC Manager, you’ll be the go-to expert for all things paid search and will have a direct impact on client performance. The role requires a strategic mindset, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to maintain clear and effective communication with both internal teams and clients.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Paid Search Strategy & Execution:

Campaign Development & Management: Develop, launch, and manage paid search campaigns on Google Ads and Bing Ads, ensuring they are aligned with client objectives and maximize ROI. This includes campaigns on Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search.

Keyword Research & Audience Targeting: Conduct extensive keyword research, competitor analysis, and audience segmentation to identify growth opportunities. Develop comprehensive strategies based on these insights to optimize targeting and bidding.

Campaign Optimization: Continuously analyze and refine campaigns to improve performance metrics such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS. Implement A/B testing strategies for ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding strategies to maximize conversions.

Ad Copy & Creative Strategy: Work closely with the creative team to ensure that ad copy, creatives, and landing pages are optimized for user engagement and aligned with campaign goals.

2. Client Communication & Consultation:

Client Liaison: Serve as the main point of contact for clients, providing expert consultation on all Google Ads and Bing Ads strategies. Clearly communicate campaign progress, adjustments, and results to ensure client satisfaction and alignment with business objectives.

Performance Reporting: Regularly prepare and present in-depth performance reports, including key performance metrics (CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and actionable insights. Use these reports to showcase campaign successes and provide strategic recommendations for optimization.

Strategic Guidance: Offer strategic recommendations to clients, advising on how to improve campaign performance, expand reach, or address performance challenges. Proactively identify opportunities for growth.

Client Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with clients, becoming a trusted advisor on paid search and digital marketing. Ensure high levels of client satisfaction, resolve campaign-related issues, and manage client expectations effectively.

3. Budget Management & Performance Tracking:

Budget Oversight: Manage and optimize client budgets across both Google Ads and Bing Ads to ensure campaigns are efficient and within budget. Track and report on budget pacing and ensure that client goals are met while maximizing ROI.

Performance Tracking & Analysis: Utilize Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other analytics platforms to monitor campaign performance in real time. Assess KPIs such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS to ensure campaigns are delivering results within the defined parameters.

Optimization: Make data-driven decisions to optimize campaigns for better performance. Adjust bids, keywords, targeting, and ads based on performance trends and competitive insights.

4. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Alignment:

Team Collaboration: Work closely with the broader digital marketing team (SEO, Social Media, Creative, Web Development) to ensure that PPC campaigns are integrated into wider marketing and sales strategies. Align campaigns with broader business objectives, ensuring a cohesive approach across all digital channels.

Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure paid search efforts align with company goals and support sales or product launch strategies.

Knowledge Sharing: Actively contribute to knowledge-sharing within the marketing team by educating peers about PPC best practices, emerging trends, and new tools or features in Google Ads and Bing Ads.

5. Industry Trend Awareness & Innovation:

Stay Current with PPC Trends: Stay up-to-date with the latest Google Ads and Bing Ads updates, features, and best practices. Attend webinars, conferences, and industry events to keep ahead of emerging trends and leverage new opportunities for clients.

Test New Strategies: Continuously evaluate and experiment with new tools, bidding strategies, and ad formats to ensure campaigns are always optimized and competitive. Propose new strategies to clients based on these findings.

6. Reporting & Data-Driven Insights:

Regular Reporting: Create and maintain regular performance reports, dashboards, and presentations to track campaign progress, analyze performance trends, and showcase ROI. Present these findings in a clear, concise manner to clients and internal teams.

Actionable Insights: Translate complex data into actionable insights that drive campaign improvements. Provide clear, data-backed recommendations to both internal and client stakeholders to guide future PPC strategies and decisions.

Attribution & Conversion Tracking: Implement and manage proper tracking systems to measure campaign effectiveness and provide accurate reporting on conversions, revenue, and other key metrics.



Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Certifications in Google Ads and Bing Ads are a plus.



Experience:

Proven PPC Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing PPC campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads. This includes experience in Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search campaigns.

Agency or Client Experience: Experience working in a client-facing role, ideally in a digital marketing agency, managing multiple PPC accounts with large-scale budgets.

Experience at Google (Bonus): Previous experience working at Google or within a Google Partner agency is highly desirable, particularly if you have in-depth knowledge of Google Ads best practices, new features, and insights from working directly with the platform.



Technical Skills:

Google Ads & Bing Ads Expertise: Advanced proficiency in managing campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads, including search, display, shopping, remarketing, and video campaigns.

Analytics Tools Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other relevant analytics and tracking tools to measure, report, and optimize PPC campaign performance.

Data Interpretation: Ability to analyze large datasets, interpret complex data, and turn insights into actionable strategies to optimize campaign performance.



Soft Skills:

Excellent Communication & Presentation Skills: Ability to explain complex PPC strategies and performance data in a clear, concise, and accessible manner for clients, internal teams, and stakeholders.

Client Management Experience: Proven experience in building and nurturing strong client relationships. Ability to manage client expectations and resolve issues in a timely and professional manner.

Problem-Solving & Proactive Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing campaign issues. Ability to think critically and take strategic action based on data.

Attention to Detail: High attention to detail, ensuring that campaign elements are precise and accurately reflect client objectives, even when working with large volumes of data.



How to Apply:

If you’re an experienced PPC Manager looking for a new challenge, we want to hear from you! Please submit your resume, along with a cover letter outlining your relevant experience. Include any specific campaigns or achievements that highlight your expertise with Google Ads and Bing Ads.

NICE TO HAVE

description:
REMOTE AV & PRODUCTION SUPPORT TECHNICIAN — RG SYSTEMS



ABOUT US

RG Systems is an embedded IT MSP based in New York City. We support software companies, fintech firms, and professional studios by living inside their Slack and Teams workspaces — we're not a help desk they ticket into; we're the IT team that works like we work there. Our media clients run live productions and need technical support that can keep up.



SHIFT

6:30AM–3:00PM EST, Monday–Friday (40 hours/week)

Please only apply if you can commit to this schedule reliably.



THE ROLE

We're looking for an AV and production support technician with real broadcast experience. You'll support live and recorded remote productions — handling talent audio, camera, and IFB setup, managing platform connections between remote contributors and studios, and keeping shows running smoothly in real time. Outside of production windows you'll support clients with general IT tickets via Slack and Jira.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Pre-production tech checks with remote talent: audio levels, microphone and interface setup, camera framing, IFB/earpiece configuration

- Operate and troubleshoot live remote production workflows using Zoom, vMix, and Singular.live

- Manage remote guest integration into live productions — audio routing, latency, codec, and platform issues

- Coordinate in real time with on-site producers, directors, and engineers via Slack or Teams during live sessions

- Guide non-technical talent through setup steps calmly and clearly under live pressure

- Support Dante-networked audio environments

- Handle general IT support tickets (account access, SaaS issues, device troubleshooting) outside of production hours

- Log all issues in Jira Service Management and document recurring problems in Confluence



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 3+ years in broadcast, live production, or AV support

- Hands-on experience with vMix and Zoom (Zoom Events, Zoom for Broadcast, or Zoom Rooms)

- Working knowledge of audio signal chains: mixers, XLR mics, USB/Dante audio interfaces, IFB systems

- Singular.live experience for live graphics

- Dante networking experience

- Comfortable troubleshooting on macOS and Windows

- Strong spoken and written English — you'll be talking talent through steps in real time on live calls

- Calm under pressure; productions do not pause for tech problems

- Reliable internet (100 Mbps up/down minimum), quiet home workspace, and a backup connection

- Ability to commit to the EST morning shift long-term



NICE TO HAVE

- Avixa CTS certification

- Dante Level 1 or 2 certification

- Experience with Wirecast, OBS, or StreamYard

- Background in broadcast television, streaming, or podcast production

- Familiarity with Comrex or LUCI Live for remote contribution



TO APPLY

Send your resume and a short note describing a live production where something went wrong and you had to fix it in real time. What broke, what did you do, and what was the outcome? We read every application.

 - Establish standards for naming, permissions, and data hygiene

 - Build the setup so it can be maintained and expanded over time

 - Structure a performance dashboard so it is simple, strategic, and useful

 - Ensure the platform helps clients understand performance and take action

 - Connect education to execution so the platform drives action, not just insight

 - Make the platform feel like an active business-growth environment rather than a static portal

 - Support client engagement through visibility, reminders, and structured planning

About the role



We are a fast-growing document preparation company that helps property owners and businesses respond to legal and regulatory situations across the United States. Flag records that do not meet our criteria and move them to an Excluded tab with a clear reason noted.

Report your daily progress and flag any blockers or questions proactively. We expect clear communication every working day.



What we are looking for



Reliable and consistent — you show up every day Monday through Friday and communicate immediately if anything comes up

Comfortable working independently without needing constant supervision

Experience with Google Sheets or Excel

Comfortable navigating US government websites and public record databases

Basic English communication skills — clear written updates required

Stable internet connection and a dedicated workspace



What we are NOT looking for



Someone who disappears for days without notice

Someone who submits incomplete or unverified data

Someone who needs to be chased for updates

Someone looking for occasional part time work — this is a full time commitment



Hours and pay



Full time — 40 hours per week — Monday through Friday

First 45 days is a standard probation period — rate confirmed at hiring

Paid twice a month on the 1st and 15th via Wise or PayPal

The Vendor Coordinator serves as a critical bridge between onboarding, operations, cleaning coordination, repairs & maintenance, and vendor management.

This role is primarily responsible for building and maintaining our nationwide vendor network by sourcing, interviewing, vetting, onboarding, training, and launching independent contractors into our systems and processes. 

The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable communicating with vendors by phone, able to manage multiple projects simultaneously, and proactive in identifying solutions rather than simply following existing processes.

In addition to vendor acquisition and onboarding, this position supports special projects, utility setup and transfers, damage claim management, and provides cross-functional support to operational departments when needed.

Key Responsibilities

Vendor Recruitment, Vetting & Onboarding

This is the primary responsibility of the role.

Source, recruit, and onboard independent contractors nationwide

Identify qualified cleaners, handymen, maintenance technicians, landscapers, pool technicians, hot tub technicians, inspectors, runners, trash services, and specialty vendors

Research local markets and develop vendor coverage in new and existing service areas

Contact prospective vendors by phone, text,
, and other outreach methods

Conduct vendor interviews and qualification assessments

Gather and compare vendor quotes, pricing, service offerings, and availability

Verify vendor qualifications, insurance, experience, and professionalism

Evaluate vendors against company standards to determine overall fit

Negotiate pricing and service expectations when appropriate

Complete vendor onboarding and documentation requirements

Train vendors on company policies, procedures, quality standards, communication expectations, and software systems

Ensure vendors are fully operational and capable of servicing assigned properties

Build and maintain backup vendor coverage across all active markets

Continuously improve vendor coverage, quality, response times, and operational efficiency throughout the portfolio

Special Projects & Vendor Coordination

Coordinate vendor-related projects for new property onboarding and existing property improvements

Source and obtain quotes from contractors and specialty vendors for repairs, upgrades, installations, furnishing projects, and special initiatives

Serve as the primary point of contact between vendors and internal teams throughout project execution

Coordinate vendor scheduling, communication, and project timelines

Work closely with the Onboarding Team, Interior Design Team, and Operations Team to ensure project goals are achieved

Monitor project progress and proactively address delays or issues

Ensure projects are completed accurately, on time, within budget, and according to scope

Damage Claims & Reimbursement Management

Manage guest damage and reimbursement claims from start to finish

Collect supporting documentation, photos, invoices, videos, vendor estimates, and other evidence

Prepare and submit claims through Airbnb AirCover, Safely, security deposit programs, and other claim platforms

Track claims throughout the review and approval process

Follow up consistently with platforms, insurance providers, vendors, and guests as necessary

Ensure approved claims are paid and properly documented

Identify opportunities to improve claim success rates and recovery amounts

Property Operations Support

Assist with utility account setup, transfers, and service activations for new properties

Coordinate internet, electric, gas, water, trash, and other utility services when requested

Support onboarding projects by coordinating operational vendors and service providers

Cross-train with Cleaning Coordination and Repairs & Maintenance departments

Assist with cleaning, maintenance, and operational workflows during periods of increased volume

Support efforts to ensure properties remain guest-ready and operational at all times

Provide backup support to operational departments when needed

Qualifications

Required

Strong experience recruiting, hiring, vetting, onboarding, and managing independent contractors or vendors

Strong understanding of U.S. residential homes, home systems, and common property maintenance needs

Experience working directly with cleaners, contractors, handymen, maintenance technicians, and service providers

Excellent verbal English communication skills with confidence conducting interviews and vendor calls BY PHONE.

Strong written communication skills

Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities

Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously

Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills

Ability to identify process improvements and proactively solve operational challenges

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

High attention to detail and strong follow-through

Preferred

Experience in short-term rental management, hospitality, property operations, vendor management, or property management

Experience coordinating projects involving multiple vendors and contractors

Experience handling damage claims, insurance, and reimbursements

Familiarity with:

Hostaway

ClickUp

Z-Inspector

Google Workspace

Safely and AirCover claim platforms

Success Looks Like

A successful Vendor Recruitment & Operations Coordinator:

Consistently sources and hires high-quality vendors that meet company standards and budget requirements

Builds and maintains strong vendor coverage and backup coverage across all active markets

Successfully trains and launches vendors into operations with minimal issues

Coordinates projects efficiently while keeping vendors accountable to timelines, scope, and budget

Resolves damage claims accurately and maximizes claim recovery

Serves as a reliable bridge between onboarding, operations, cleaning coordination, and repairs & maintenance teams

Maintains a strong sense of ownership and accountability over assigned projects and responsibilities

Compensation & Benefits

Full-Time (40 Hours Per Week) 

PST Schedule Required

100% Remote Position

Long-Term Opportunity

Employee Stock Plan available

$6-$8/hr, depending on experience and skills



To Apply

This will be a TWO-PART APPLICATION PROCESS. To begin the application, please follow these 3 steps, below. Once completed, we will follow up to provide instructions for the second part. The second part will include a working test of your skills. 



Please submit:

1. Resume

2. A short video (3 minutes MAX) introducing yourself.  You must include the following:

-You must say “Hi FIBI” 

-Don’t read an AI-written transcript verbatim

-Briefly describe your experience sourcing vendors 

-Describe to me: 3 ways how sourcing a cleaner for an AirBnB/STR property is different from a regular home cleaner. 

-Describe to me: 3 options of how you would source an inexpensive, reliable handyman for an STR

-We’re installing an above ground hot tub for an STR in St Louis, MO. List any and all vendors we may need to source for this project to be successfully completed. 

-Briefly tell me explicitly if you have YES or NO processed damage claims on AirBnB and/or Safely

title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer & Creative Strategist
description:
The Pickleball Lab (
 & 
) is looking for an elite YouTube Thumbnail Designer who understands that a great thumbnail is 50% strategy and 50?sign. You won’t just be "making graphics"—you will be responsible for the first step in our packaging chain: CTR.



We average 1%–4% CTR (not great) and are looking for someone who can help us push a lot higher. Our Suggested Videos CTR is 1% and Browse is around 10%. Help us get higher.



What You’ll Be Doing:



- Thumbnail Strategy: You will take our video title we created for youtube and help us d
 on the thumbnail strategy. You can request specific facial expressions or poses from the owners to match your vision.

- Design & Execution: Create high-quality, custom thumbnails for the following categories of our videos:

1) Podcasts (60%)

2) Film Reviews (30%)

3) Coaching videos (10%).



- Occasional Flat Assets: Design static graphics (charts, overlays, diagrams) that our editor will turn into motion graphics for our videos.



Requirements (Must-Have):



- Advanced Photoshop Skills: You must be a true designer. No Canva. No templates. We require the final .PSD files for every project.

- CTR Strategy Mindset: You understand "Curiosity Gaps," visual storytelling, and how to stop the scroll on Suggested Videos and the YouTube Homepage.

- Communication: Excellent English is a must. You will be expected to collaborate on and explain your design choices and suggest strategy during U.S. work hours.

- Turnaround: Consistent 24-hour turnaround for thumbnails.

- Follows Instructions: You are detail-oriented and don't miss the small stuff.



Details:



- Platform: Long-form YouTube.

- Volume: Average of 7 thumbnails per month (Part
).

- Collaboration: We use Slack and Trello. You are expected to do the same.

- Assets: We provide high-quality studio-lit footage/photos. You perform the cutouts and compositing.

- Design Rules: Zero-to-two words of text (typically, open to your suggestions). Clean, standing out from the "crowded/noisy" pickleball niche.



Trial/Selection Process:

If your portfolio stands out, we will invite you to a Two-Part Test:

- Skill Test: We provide exact thumbnail instructions to see how well you follow a brief.

- Strategy Test: We provide a video topic and raw assets, and you create a thumbnail based purely on your own strategic vision.



Bonus & Compensation:

- Starting as a part-time contractor with the potential to move into a full-time role if our needs require it down the line (not a given)

- We are open to performance bonuses for significant jumps in Click-Through Rate. This would have to be negotiated down the line.



When you apply send me:



1. Cost per thumbnail



2. Any bulk discounts you give



3. How many revisions?



4. Are you open to doing the 2 part test project so we can see your skills? You may watermark the thumbnail. If we like it, we may purchase it from you.



5. Link your portfolio of youtube thumbnails



6. Link your portfolio of other graphic design assets



7. Do you have extensive experience in Photoshop? If so, detail your experience here. If not, please do not apply.



8. Do you use AI at all? If so, which ones? And what do you use it for?



9. Talk about your experience designing youtube thumbnails



10. Talk about your experience with youtube thumbnail strategy (if you have any)



11. Have you ever worked on a YouTube strategy team where they had strategy calls, etc. and if so, what was that experience like?



12. Have you ever adjusted your strategy based on YouTube's analytics like CTR, etc.? If so, explain more.



13. Why do you think you'd be a good fit for this project?



14. Do you play pickleball, tennis, ping pong or any other sports?



15. Any other information you think would be helpful



Looking forward to speaking with you!

title: Customer Support Coordinator — Permanent Lighting Company (US-Based) $4.00/hr + Performance Bonuses
description:
About the Company

We install premium permanent outdoor LED lighting systems on homes across the United States. Think custom-color Christmas lights that stay up year-round — except high-end, professionally installed, and built to last a lifetime. Our customers pay $3,000–$10,000 for their systems and expect a premium experience from start to finish. We're a fast-growing company and we take care of the people on our team.



What You'll Be Doing

This role has two main responsibilities:

1. Roof Measurements (approx. 2–3 hours per morning/afternoon)



Using EagleView and RoofSnap (we'll train you), pull roof measurements for upcoming sales appointments

Calculate linear footage per side of the home using a simple formula we'll teach you

Enter measurements into our CRM (HighLevel) before each appointment's start time — this is time-sensitive and directly tied to your bonus

Handle edge cases like new builds and late appointment confirmations

Flag anything that doesn't look right rather than guessing



2. Customer Inbound Support (remaining hours)



Respond to customer messages in our CRM via text and

Answer inbound phone calls from customers asking about their installation timeline, materials status, or general questions

Look up project status in our systems and give clear, accurate updates

De-escalate frustrated customers calmly and professionally — we'll give you scripts and context

Log notes and escalate anything you can't resolve



This is detail-oriented, process-driven work. We have documented SOPs for everything. You won't be figuring things out on your own — you'll be following a clear system and flagging when something falls outside of it.



Compensation

Base pay: $5.00/hr

Performance bonuses — paid:



Measurements Deadline Bonus: You earn a bonus for every appointment where measurements are uploaded before the appointment start time. Miss the deadline, no bonus. 

Call Answer Rate Bonus: You earn a bonus based on the percentage of inbound customer calls you answer during your shift. We track this.  Targets and bonus amounts will be shared during the interview.



We built the bonus structure this way intentionally — if you're reliable and consistent, you make meaningfully more than the base rate. If you're not, the base is what you get. We want someone who sees the bonus as the norm, not the exception.



You're a Great Fit If You:



Have experience in customer support (phone and chat) — 2+ years preferred

Are extremely reliable and show up on time, every day

Communicate clearly in written and spoken English

Can follow a multi-step process accurately without skipping steps

Are comfortable learning new software tools (we'll train you — but you need to be a fast learner)

Have a stable internet connection and a quiet place to take calls

Are available to start your shift by 6:00 a.m. EST





You're Not a Fit If You:



Need constant supervision to complete routine tasks

Have unreliable internet or frequent power outages with no backup

Are looking for a short-term gig — we want someone long-term

Skip instructions in job applications (more on that below)





The Details



Pay: $5/hr base + performance bonuses

Hours: Part-time to start (~20 hrs/week), with the opportunity to grow to full-time as you prove yourself

Schedule: Monday–Sunday, morning shift aligned to US Central/Eastern time

Equipment: You must have your own computer and reliable internet. A headset for calls is required.

Start date: As soon as the right person is found





How to Apply

We receive a lot of applications. To make sure we find the right person, we ask everyone to complete a short Google Form before we consider your application. It takes about 5 minutes.

Do not send a message here asking for more information. Do not send a resume attachment. Only applications submitted through the form will be reviewed.



Click the link below to apply:





If you can follow that one simple instruction, you're already ahead of most applicants.

title: AI Focused Full Stack Developer - Ongoing Projects
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Access Adventure Club is an Australian company on a mission to connect young people with nature, to improve the wellbeing of our next generation. We predominantly achieve this through delivering our Accessible Adventure programs for young people with disabilities.



We have been in operation for 10 years and are leaders in a uniquely positioned niche that falls between education, disability support and tourism in Australia. We currently have a team of 15 full time staff and approximately 40 casual staff. This includes 9 high performing full time staff in the Philippines. 



Our core values are:

1. We resonate good vibes.

2. We are hungry to contribute to the company's purpose

3. We are highly organized and disciplined

4. We are adaptable to change

5. We are optimists, with can-do attitudes

6. We see challenge as an opportunity for growth



As our Full Stack AI Developer, you will work with us on an ongoing, project-based contract. You will be a cornerstone in our company, leveraging cutting-edge AI software platforms to transform our business in many departments - starting off with our marketing function. Your engagement is structured around distinct milestone projects.





FIRST PROJECT: Use AI to Optimize our Meta Paid Ads

It's up to you to d
 how you would optimize our ads, you'll have the creative freedom to choose which method to deploy. Some example may include:



- Designing, building, and deploying autonomous marketing agents and / or web applications using Claude or the Lovable app development platform, or equivalent.

- Integrating internal data workflows directly with the Meta Graph API and webhooks to build live campaign analytics dashboards.

- Prompt engineer sophisticated marketing data agents in Lovable capable of analyzing historical data, identifying underperforming ads, and outputting winning ad text and graphic variations, and audience targeting rules.

- Connecting external databases (e.g., Supabase, PostgreSQL) to ensure seamless flow between our AI agents and active Meta ad campaigns.





ONGOING & FUTURE PROJECTS: Finance, Operations, Sales, HR and more Marketing

Collaborate directly with departmental managers, to work on projects that can be automated or done by AI agents, allowing our staff to have more time back. We currently have approximately 40+ projects that can be done right away (some minor and some major) - so you'll have no shortage of ongoing projects to keep you busy.



Act as our internal "vibe coder," rapid-prototyping custom applications and autonomous data subagents in Lovable, Claude or equivalent software, to replace manual, repetitive workflows across Sales, Finance, Operations, and HR once the marketing phase is complete.



Maintain clear, thorough documentation of all newly deployed AI applications, database architecture, and API endpoints for each completed project.



Your Main successful indicators will be based around number of projects completed, as well as quality scores and number of bugs reported for each of your projects. Ultimately, you will use AI software and your development expertise to make the working lives of our tea
mbers satisfyingly easier, project by project.





THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:

- is responsive and communicates promptly during Australian Daytime hours (day shift in the Philippines)

- is highly organized, process-driven and will document things properly.

- has good written and verbal English communication skills

- is looking for a long term, stable work coming in, but still with the flexibility to take on other work if needed

- has deep experience with AI-assisted software building, and "vibe coding,"

- understands full-stack development foundations (strong knowledge of data structures, databases like Supabase/PostgreSQL, and connecting external REST APIs/webhooks.

- is highly skilled at Prompt Engineering—knowing how to logically structure instructions to guide AI engines





OTHER REQUIREMENTS:

- Stable internet connection

- A proper home office, free from distraction

- Availability during Day Shift Hours (only 80% of your work needs to be done within 9am - 6pm Adelaide Timezone) 20% of your work can be done outside these hours.





WHY WORK WITH US:

- Australian Day Shift - 6:30am to 3:30pm PH Time (regular schedule after DST 7:30am to 4:30pm PH Time)

- We have an extremely strong culture built upon our core values, that focuses on our staff wellbeing, including company meditation on Monday and Friday, staff recognition and an optional staff professional development plan.

- Hourly rate paid twice per month via Wise (no conversion fee) pay depends on work completed and hours done.



If you prefer fulltime permanent employment (instead of project based), we are happy to offer a slightly lower base pay, but include:

- Additional 13th-month Pay

- Additional Monthly Contributions to SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG

- 20 Annual Leave Credits

- Paid public holiday days off (based on South Australian calendar) - this is in addition to leave credits.

- Training and other career development opportunities

- Stable and growing company

- Birthday and Christmas Gifts

- HMO paid for, with MaxiCare or another provider





HOW TO APPLY:

This opportunity is not for you if you do not meet the above-mentioned job requirements. However, if you believe you are the superstar Ai Focused Full Stack Developer that our youth deserve, then please send us the following things in your application message:



1. A link of your updated resume (in pdf please)

2. A cover letter explaining why you believe you would suit this role (in PDF please)

3. The biggest thing we will consider - please share a link to, or attach a video of you, explaining how you would optimize our Meta ads (assume you have any paid-for software available to you). 



If selected to progress, we will ask you to do what you have explained on your video, as part of our assessment process. We will be happy to pay you for that time spent, and give you temporary access to software you require. 



You will only be contacted if you have met the above requirements and included your resume, cover letter and the all-important video.

title: Video Editor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



Alloy is a growth partner for association management companies across the U.S. We’re looking for a

Video Production Specialist to join our team and produce high-volume, polished video content

across a range of formats—from marketing campaigns to educational content to social media.

You’ll be our go-to person for all things video. That means you should be just as comfortable editing

a talking-head interview as you are assembling a complex piece with mixed assets like motion

graphics, screen recordings, and slide-based visuals. Because we work with multiple clients across

different industries and brand voices, you’ll need to adapt your style and creative approach to match

each client’s tone, aesthetic, and audience.



This is not a “wait for footage” role. Our clients rarely have existing video assets, so you’ll need to be

a resourceful creator who can build compelling content from scratch using stock footage, AI-

generated media, motion graphics, and original assets. You’ll work alongside strategists and account

managers who handle ideation and client relationships, but you’ll have significant creative ownership

over how content comes to life.



WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON

   • Marketing videos — promotional content, brand storytelling, product explainers, and

campaign assets

   • Talking-head videos — clean, professional edits with dynamic pacing, lower thirds, b-roll

cutaways, and branded overlays

   • Webinar and presentation edits — transforming raw webinar recordings and slide decks

into polished, engaging content

   • E-course and learning content — lesson videos for online courses, including multi-format

edits that blend talking head, slides, screen captures, and graphics

   • Social media clips — short-form vertical and horizontal cuts optimized for Instagram,

TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn

   • Mixed-asset production — assembling final videos from a variety of source materials

including talking-head footage, motion graphics, static graphics, and audio tracks

   • Stock footage and AI-generated content — sourcing, curating, and creatively repurposing

stock footage and AI-generated visuals to build narratives when original footage is

unavailable

   • Template and asset library management — maintaining organized project files, branded

templates, and reusable asset libraries to support high-volume output without sacrificing

quality



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Must-Have

   • Proven experience in video production and post-production, with a portfolio that

demonstrates range across multiple video formats



Adobe Creative Suite proficiency:



– Premiere Pro — your primary editing environment

– After Effects — for motion graphics, compositing, and visual polish

– Photoshop — for asset creation, thumbnail design, and graphic prep

– Audition — for audio cleanup, mixing, and mastering



AI video tool fluency — you actively use AI-powered tools (e.g., Runway, Descript, HeyGen,

ElevenLabs, Opus Clip, CapCut, Pika, or similar) to accelerate production without sacrificing quality.

This is a major requirement—we want someone who is already integrating AI into their workflow, not

just curious about it.



   • Familiarity with AI-powered research and scripting workflows (e.g., Google NotebookLM,

Claude, ChatGPT) for content development and scripting support

   • Demonstrated ability to build polished video content from stock footage, screen recordings,

and limited source material—you don’t wait for perfect assets to start creating

   • Strong eye for quality—every deliverable should feel polished and professional, whether it’s

a 15-second social clip or a 45-minute course module

   • Ability to work with mixed media—comfortable combining talking-head footage, motion

graphics, static slides, screen recordings, and audio into cohesive final products

   • Strong eye for pacing, color grading, typography, and sound design

   • Comfortable working across formats: horizontal (YouTube/web), vertical

(Reels/TikTok/Shorts), and square (social)

   • Reliable communication and availability—responsive, proactive, and comfortable working

asynchronously across time zones



Nice-to-Have

   • Animation skills (2D motion design, character animation, kinetic typography, Lottie, etc.)

   • Experience with color grading and advanced audio design

   • Familiarity with YouTube optimization (thumbnails, chapters, end screens)

   • Experience producing content for marketing funnels or growth campaigns

   • Experience in an agency or white-label environment serving multiple brands

   • Familiarity with the HOA, property management, or real estate industry

   • Basic knowledge of SEO and social media distribution strategies for video content

   • Experience with DaVinci Resolve or other editing platforms

   • Illustration, graphic design, or 3D motion skills

   • Ability to work from creative briefs with minimal hand-holding



WHAT WE OFFER

   • Fully remote position with flexible scheduling

   • The opportunity to shape a growing creative function from the ground up

   • A collaborative, low-ego team that values speed, quality, and resourcefulness

   • Exposure to a wide variety of client industries and creative challenges

   • Room to grow as our video capabilities expand across the client portfolio



HOW TO APPLY

Please submit:



1. Your portfolio or showreel — we want to see range. Include examples of talking-head

edits, mixed-asset videos, social clips, and any course/webinar content you’ve produced.

Bonus points for work where you built something compelling without much source material.

2. A brief note on your AI workflow — tell us which AI tools you use, how you use them, and

how they’ve improved your speed or output quality.

3. Your availability and preferred working hours.

We value speed, quality, and creative problem-solving. If you’re someone who’s constantly leveling

up your toolkit and can deliver professional-grade video content efficiently, we’d love to hear from

you.

4. 2–3 minute video intro (Loom or Drive link)

5. Please share your video portfolio



***  Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. ***

title: Essay Editor/Academic Writer
description:
We’re an academic consulting firm that helps high school students gain admission to top-tier universities in the U.S., and we’re currently seeking a part-time Essay Editor/Academic Writer with strong writing, editing, and critical thinking skills to join our team.



This role is ideal for someone who can take rough or underdeveloped student essays and turn them into polished, well-structured pieces that read naturally and professionally. The position is part-time and flexible, but it’s also deadline-driven and requires strong reliability, responsiveness, and attention to detail.



This is not a general content writing role. We’re specifically looking for someone who can revise and rewrite essays so they are clearer, stronger, and more compelling while still aligning with the original prompt, intended message, and required word count.



Key Responsibilities:

• Edit and rewrite high school-level essays based on specific prompts and word count requirements, improving structure, clarity, grammar, tone, and overall impact.

• Manage multiple essay assignments at once while meeting tight turnaround times, typically within 24–48 hours, and communicate proactively regarding deadlines or issues that may affect delivery.



Applicants should be able to:

• Rewrite and strengthen weak or underdeveloped drafts without losing the original intent, while elevating flow, structure, readability, and overall quality.

• Demonstrate excellent grammar, sentence control, and word choice, and write with a level of polish that reads as fluent and natural in English.



To proceed with your application, please send a message with your resume, 2-3 writing samples for review, and an estimate of how many hours you can commit each week.

title: Video Editor
description:
Role Summary



We’re hiring a Video Editor to help us turn raw footage into clean, engaging videos for social media and YouTube. You’ll be editing content that ranges from short-form clips to longer YouTube videos, with a strong focus on speed, consistency, and attention to detail.



Responsibilities

 • Edit raw footage into polished deliverables for:

 • Short-form (Reels/TikTok/Shorts)

 • Long-form YouTube videos

 • Ads, promos, and training clips (as needed)

 • Create tight, punchy cuts with strong pacing and storytelling

 • Add simple motion graphics, lower thirds, callouts, and basic titles

 • Clean up audio (levels, noise reduction, EQ where needed)

 • Color correct / apply basic color grading for a consistent look

 • Sync audio/video and organize timelines cleanly

 • Export in correct formats/aspect ratios (9:16, 16:9, 1:1) with proper settings

 • Collaborate with our team on notes, revisions, and versioning

 • Maintain file organization and naming conventions in shared drives

 • Hit deadlines reliably and communicate early if anything slips



Requirements (Must-Have)

 • Adobe Premiere Pro experience (required)

 • Strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere + at least one of: After Effects, Audition, Photoshop)

 • Reliable high-speed internet suitable for uploading/downloading large video files

 • Must have your own editing equipment, including:

 • Capable computer for 1080p/4K editing

 • Headphones for audio editing

 • Stable power/backup plan if outages are common

 • Ability to follow brand style, pacing references, and feedback precisely

 • Strong English comprehension (spoken fluency not required, but must understand notes)



Nice-to-Have

 • After Effects experience (templates, light animation, motion graphics)

 • Experience editing for direct-response ads and retention-focused YouTube content

 • Familiarity with:

 • Captions/subtitles (burned-in or SRT workflows)

 • Sound design (whooshes, hits, subtle SFX)

 • Multi-cam editing

 • Experience working with remote teams and asynchronous workflows



Deliverables & Expectations

 • Fast turnaround with consistent quality

 • Willingness to do revisions quickly and professionally

 • Organized project files, clean timelines, and consistent exports

 • Ability to work in overlapping hours with U.S. team (partial overlap preferred but not required)



Work Setup

 • Remote

 • Full-time 

 • Long-term opportunity for the right editor

title: Online Community Growth Specialist (Remote)
description:
The Clinical CEO is a coaching brand that helps licensed clinicians build scalable, systems-driven practices. Our community is where therapists and practice owners come to grow. We are hiring (3) three Online Community Growth Specialists to grow and engage that community across
, Instagram, Reddit, LinkedIn, and other relevant online groups. This is warm relationship-building work, not cold sales.



The Role

You will build genuine, professional relationships inside therapy and coaching spaces online, bring the right people into our group and keep our community active and engaged. You represent our brand directly to an audience of clinicians, so professionalism and excellent written English are essential.



Positions and Shifts (Philippine Time)



We are hiring three people:

One (1) graveyard shift, 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine time.

Two (2) shifts, 4:00 PM to 1:00 AM Philippine time.

1-hour lunch hour is included in this time



Compensation

PHP 20,000 per month, paid twice monthly on the 15th and the last day of each month.



Team Growth Bonus

On top of base pay, the whole team shares a monthly growth bonus based on total new members across our communities. When the team hits 2,500 new members in a month, each member earns PHP 1,500. When the team hits 3,500 or more, each member earns PHP 2,500. The bonus releases only when growth comes through legitimate joins and no account has been restricted or banned, so quality protects everyone's pay.



Path to Setter Role

Strong performers with excellent spoken English skills can move up into a commission-based setter role, where earnings are significantly higher. This role is the proving ground for that opportunity.



What You Will Do

Community management

Manage and moderate our owned communities, primarily on
. Welcome new members, answer questions, and keep daily conversation active and on brand. Create and schedule posts, prompts, and discussion threads that drive engagement. Remove spam and enforce guidelines. Surface common member questions and themes for the wider team.



Multi-platform growth and outreach

Identify and participate in relevant therapy and coaching communities across
, Instagram, Reddit, LinkedIn, and other online groups. Engage through genuine, professional conversation that respects each platform's culture and rules. Start authentic relationships that bring the right people into the group. Follow up warmly with prospective members and nurture them in. Log your daily activity and track conversion in our systems.



Requirements

Excellent written English, warm, clear, and professional in tone. Strong working knowledge of
, Instagram, Reddit, and LinkedIn, including how outreach and self-promotion differ on each platform. Familiarity with the coaching and therapeutic space, enough to speak credibly and respectfully with clinicians. Highly organized, self-managed, and consistent with daily activity. Professionalism and discretion at all times. A working computer, a quiet space during your shift, and steady internet with a backup internet device in case of outages.



A background or genuine interest in social work, counselling, psychology, or wellness is a strong bonus but not required, as long as you can show professionalism and learn the space quickly.



Key Performance Indicators

Meaningful conversations: 80 to 120 genuine, personalized conversations/comments per day across platforms combined, spaced and authentic, never identical blasts.



Team growth: contribute to the team's monthly new member target, with a 30-day ramp before full targets apply.



Engagement: help maintain or grow daily active members and post engagement inside our community month over month.



Platform health: zero account restrictions or bans, by respecting each platform's posting and messaging rules.



Response time: reply to member questions and comments within your shift window.



Reporting: Submit an end-of-shift activity log each day.



Retention and quality: legitimate joins and low member churn, measured monthly.



How to Apply

1. Apply with a video about your experience with online communities and the platforms above (answer the questions below)

2. Send a sample of your written English. No AI allowed, we can tell! 

3. Tell us which shift you are applying for.



Questions

1. Tell us about yourself and which shift you are applying for, and confirm you can work those hours consistently in Philippine time.

2. Which of these platforms have you actually used for community work or outreach:
, Instagram, Reddit, LinkedIn? 3. Walk us through what you did and what results you saw. (If you have proof even better)

4. Our audience is licensed therapists and clinicians. How would you start a warm, genuine conversation with someone like that without sounding salesy or fake?

5. Reddit and LinkedIn treat self-promotion very differently from
 and Instagram. What do you know about staying within each platform's rules so an account does not get restricted or banned?

Tell us about a time you handled a difficult or sensitive person online with professionalism. What did you do?

This role grows our community through real relationships, not spam or mass messaging. Why does that approach matter, and why do you want to do this kind of work?

What is your internet setup, and what is your backup plan when your main connection goes down?

title: VIRTUAL INTAKE SPECIALIST & DATA COORDINATOR
description:
Position: Virtual Intake Specialist / Receptionist

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Reports to: Senior Paralegal

Firm Focus: United States Family-Based Immigration & Citizenship



I. ROLE PURPOSE



The Virtual Intake Specialist serves as the firm’s "Manager of First Impressions." You are the primary point of contact for all potential and existing clients. Your goal is to provide a warm, empathetic, and professional experience while ensuring all data is captured accurately in our systems to facilitate rapid case production and maintain the firm's reputation for excellence.



II. WORKING HOURS



Shift: 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Standard Time (PST).



Alignment: This role requires full synchronization with U.S. business hours to provide real-time support to clients and the legal team.



III. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Strategic Gatekeeping & Reception

Professional Greeting: Respond to all incoming telephone calls and inquiries promptly to build immediate trust.



Standardized Screening: Use the firm's standardized questionnaires to screen leads for eligibility and "fit" before scheduling them with the Senior Paralegal or Attorney.



Relationship Management: Maintain tact, clarity, and warmth in every interaction, ensuring clients feel their concerns are understood and respected.



2. Data Integrity & Workflow Automation

Standardized Intake: Guide new clients through the Case Management Software digital questionnaires to ensure a "single source of truth" for all biographical data.



Case Initiation: Prepare initial digital file folders and ensure all core documents (passports, birth certificates, etc.) are uploaded and named according to firm standards.



System Maintenance: Update case notes and status fields in the Case Management Software immediately following any client interaction to ensure real-time accuracy for the legal team.



3. Client Care & Responsiveness

Proactive Follow-ups: Use automated tools and direct outreach to "push" clients to complete their document checklists within the firm's required onboarding window.



Expectation Management: Provide clients with a clear summary of the firm's process so they understand their responsibilities and the next steps in their legal journey.



IV. REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES (KSAs)



Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English skills; ability to convey complex information clearly without using unnecessary "legalese."



Technology Proficiency: High level of comfort with Case Management Software, document automation tools, and VoIP phone systems.



Attention to Detail: Absolute accuracy in data entry; understanding that a single misspelling or date error can have significant legal consequences.



Ethics & Confidentiality: Strict adherence to client confidentiality protocols and a clear understanding that you cannot provide legal advice or interpret the law.



V. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



Connectivity: Reliable high-speed internet connection; must have a secured mobile hotspot and power station available as a back-up.



Security: Must follow the firm’s Secure Password Policy and use an approved password manager.



Environment: A quiet, private professional workspace suitable for handling confidential client phone calls.



VI. FIRM CULTURE (THE CARE FRAMEWORK)



We are a high-performance firm that values:



Consistency: Working from the same playbook every time to ensure quality.



Agility: Finding opportunities to follow through and move cases forward immediately.



Responsiveness: Prioritizing the client's experience and peace of mind.



Efficiency: Leveraging technology to produce extraordinary quality with less manual effort.
